prompt: A hyper-realistic Halloween witch in a claustrophobic underground stone tunnel, captured as if with a modern smartphone camera. Slight wide-angle lens distortion, faint digital noise, and a subtle handheld shake effect, giving the photo a raw, authentic feel. The witch has an exaggeratedly large crooked nose, wrinkled pale skin, piercing glowing eyes, and messy gray hair falling over her shoulders. She wears a ragged black cloak, faint glowing runes shining on it, illuminating the damp mossy tunnel walls. Water drips from the ceiling, reflections glisten on the stones, creating a suffocating claustrophobic vibe. The witch leans unnaturally close toward the phone camera, almost invading personal space, with a sinister grin, as if she’s about to whisper a curse. Extreme realism, cinematic horror atmosphere, DSLR quality yet with smartphone imperfections, no blood. --chaos 20 --ar 9:16 --raw --profile 6z1eipk
